mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs in a month), a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating supply chain resilience, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' pricing power increases.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling robust housing demand, consumer spending increases, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of quarters with HOUST above its 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a dovish monetary stance with contained inflation supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A single-month spike in UNRATE above 5.5%, indicating labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors reassess economic growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE above 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, RSAFS growth (> $300k) serves as a proxy for robust consumer demand, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the broader economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of RSAFS growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
